title: Approval
description: An approval record (docs/design/m0/04 "Approval records"): who approved which action on which exact object state, under which grant and confirmation. change_class is computed by internal/authority from the effective change, never supplied. Approvals are append-only; supersedes is explicit lineage, and a revocation or narrower scope wins over an earlier, wider one.

proposal.description: The one proposal a confirmed approval answers (null only under policy none, which internal/authority does not persist in this build). Every field it shares with the proposal is copied from the proposal record, never supplied, and internal/authority admits it only while they match.

change_class.description: The sensitive change classes the effective change contains; empty when none.

scope.description: The action's parameters; one schema per action, from the action registry.

confirmation.description: A confirmed policy records its evidence: human needs its consumed challenge, and both human and independent_review name the events that satisfied them. Whether that evidence applies is internal/authority's check.

satisfied_by.description: The events that satisfied the confirmation (a consumed challenge, an applicable review receipt).

answers.description: The owed inputs this approval answers, derived from an input.answer scope; an approval that merely mentions an id answers nothing.

question.description: What the actor was asked (from the proposal or packet).

answer_verbatim.description: The actor's own words, when a human answered.

ChangeClass.description: Sensitive change classes and their supervisor confirmation defaults are in docs/design/m0/04 (D32, K5, KA1, M12).

ObjectRef.description: The exact object the action applies to: its version, its digest, or both, never neither (version 0: the object does not exist yet).

ExpectedState.description: The object state the action was decided against: its version (seq of its last event), its content digest, or both, never neither.
